shuttle.heading: Shuttle Bus Timetable
notes: Pick-up and drop-off points: Marula Café / Batoka Safaris, and The Rainforest.
Clients wishing to board the bus from the hotel should notify the porter and be at Reception by the pick-up times above.
For the return trip, notify the driver where you need to be picked up and the time.
